notes: This contract records portable C++ TCK checks for the official IEEE 1516.1 declaration-management surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador API and standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. The existing contract checks object and interaction publication, active and passive subscription, withdrawal, pre-connect and pre-join service boundaries, and invalid declaration-handle failures. The direct §5.9.4 mapping is limited to the separate unsubscribe-last-attribute scenario: after the only subscribed attribute of an object class is removed, a subsequently registered instance produces no Discover Object Instance callback. No provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior are asserted; this remains experimental API evidence, not conformance.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador object and interaction publication/subscription lifecycle
